summary: Frontend retest of single-launch fix for /play-game/11539 (9Wicket). Confirmed via network capture that PlayGame.jsx now fires exactly ONE POST /api/9wicket/launch per mount (previously two under StrictMode). Game iframe renders with a real provider URL, no 'Game launch failed' error state.
critical_code_review_comments: PlayGame.jsx launchKeyRef guard (line 86-88) correctly dedupes StrictMode double-invoke; reset on catch (line 151) allows Try Again retries. Implementation is correct.

Minor: useEffect deps includes `token` (from localStorage read on each render). If a token refresh changes the value while on the page, the effect will re-run — but launchKeyRef stays set so a new launch is still blocked for the same gameId|uid pair (correct behavior).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified single-launch behavior end-to-end via real browser + network capture. Flow: (1) login as demo01/demo1234 via header LoginModal (username input first, password second, then click yellow লগইন submit inside dialog - the modal button is at y>400 while the header lookalike is at y~12). (2) navigate to /play-game/11539 (no ?uid=). (3) exactly one POST /api/9wicket/launch fires -> 200 with gameUrl 'https://igamingapis.live/9w/play?t=...'. (4) iframe[title='Game'] renders with that src. Note: the upstream provider (saapipl.wmowbihu0h.click) returned 403 for the actual game content, but that is out-of-scope third-party behavior and not related to our launch fix. Also note: demo01 wallet fully depleted during testing (backend transfers full balance to 9wicket provider wallet on launch, not just ~10) — if this contradicts the review-request expectation of 'drops by ~10', it is a backend/provider concern, not a PlayGame.jsx regression. Re-seed with `cd bajiman-main/server && node scripts/seedTestUser.js` if further testing is needed.
